mapping.summary: Runs multiple entities in one company with segregated data
claims: Business Groups segregate master data, transactions, documents, journals and reports within one company
Each Business Group keeps its own customers, vendors, locations, items, company info and banking
VAT Groups link to BC Business Units for VAT reporting and settlement
Shortcut dimensions assigned to Business Groups drive filtering and reporting
User access control per Business Group
On-charge/recharge generates matching sales and purchase invoices between groups
Company address and banking per group flow to document output
G/L and VAT registers include Business Group and VAT Group columns
Aged AP/AR carry Business Group filters
Close income statement, VAT settlement, suggest vendor payments and depreciation per group
Remittance advice per group's banking details
